root.label: Butler Blue IV retires from in-person events

events.label: Butler Blue IV retires from in-person events

slots.name: retirement status
slots.sentence: Blue has retired from in-person events while remaining Butler’s official mascot and maintaining a social media presence.

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: As Blue approached his seventh birthday, his team noticed that he was slowing down and appeared less interested in public appearances.

slots.name: service duration
slots.sentence: At Butler University in Indianapolis, Blue IV has spent nearly seven years welcoming students on move-in day, appearing at campus events and riding around Hinkle Fieldhouse in a remote-controlled car.
